incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: smart-routing service showing increased error rate and region fallback loops after config push. Paging on-call.
Maya R: acked. I'm jumping on it, pinging @Ryan L for routing policy context.
Ryan L: on it. Any indicators which env/config push triggered this?
Maya R: timeline: config-schema-change merged 14m ago (PR #4823). Prod push at +5m. Errors started ~8m after push. EU region traffic is seeing retries and variant mismatch errors.
Alex T: seeing 502s -> backend variant not compatible: logs show requests routed to "variant: prod-legacy" which is wrong for these models.
Maya R: this looks like the schema change deprecated `preferred_variant` field but the parser now treats missing field as empty -> fallback logic chooses "prod-legacy" as safe default. That's surprising.
Ryan L: can you paste the offending policy payload?
Maya R: paste below (sanitized):
```
{ "policy_id": "route-23", "match": { "region": "eu" }, "routes": [{ "weight": 100, "model": "gpt-neo-20b" }], "deprecated_field": null }
```
Maya R: previously we had `preferred_variant: "v2-eu"`. New schema removed that and the runtime mapping code has a fallback map:
```
// simplified
if (!policy.preferred_variant) { selected_variant = default_variant || "prod-legacy" }
```
Kevin (CS): getting flagged by 2 customers in EU, high latency and token truncation. CS is proactively reaching out.
Sara P: can we put a temporary global override to force variant v2-eu for region eu?
Ryan L: yes. Two mitigations: (1) push a policy patch to explicitly set preferred_variant for affected policies, (2) set runtime override env ROUTING_FALLBACK_OVERRIDE=\"v2-eu\" for eu cluster. I'll do (2) first.
Maya R: I'm editing the policies; preparing a batch patch. Will run a dry-run then apply.
deploy-bot: Starting environment change: set env ROUTING_FALLBACK_OVERRIDE on cluster eu-canary.
Ryan L: applied override to eu-canary. Monitoring.
Alex T: error rate on eu-canary dropped 85% in 45s. Good sign.
Maya R: pushed policy patches to 6 affected policies. Command used:
```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://control-plane/v1/policies/route-23 \
  -d '{"preferred_variant": "v2-eu"}'
```
Maya R: applied patches. Routing stabilized, no more fallback loops.
Kevin (CS): telling the customers it's mitigated and we will follow up with RCA.
Ryan L: root cause: schema change removed deprecated field but the parser did not map old configs -> new default_variant mapping. The runtime had a hardcoded default "prod-legacy" which is incompatible for some model families; combined with region mismatch caused repeated fallbacks and retries.
Sara P: creating an incident page now and will include impacted customers + timeline.
Maya R: tagging for postmortem. Action items: 1) add migration path in schema upgrade script to translate `preferred_variant` into `variant` 2) remove hard-coded prod-legacy default or make it explicit opt-in 3) add unit tests for fallback behavior 4) alert if default fallback is used in >0.1% of traffic.
Ryan L: I'll own hotfix PR to parser to map deprecated fields and add defensive logging. ETA 2h.
Maya R: handing off to @Sara P for customer comms and postmortem. On-call handing over at 1789457000.
Sara P: taking over. Notifying stakeholders and scheduling postmortem meeting.
incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED at 1789457045. Severity: Sev2 -> customer-impacting but mitigated. Postmortem: link to /ops/incidents/1789456789 (draft). :white_check_mark:
